name: List
summary: Write and check off simple lists
description: Make checklists and manage items with the keypad and directional buttons. Designed for errands, packing and other short lists.
author: thooton

changes.text: Common: setup files written whole from any thread, leftover setup files cleaned up, and every app on common bumped.
Build and publish immutable Wave package releases alongside the legacy channel.
Turn Android backup on in every app, so adb backup can move their data to another phone.
The menu now fits on screen, so Delete is never cut off.
One Back always closes the task sheet, and a full list says so before you type.
Down in the task sheet reaches Save, and opening Completed at the bottom shows its first task.
The To-do and Completed redesign, as 1.2.1 was already published.
Pare the screen down to the To-do and Completed cards.
Round every app's launcher icon like Canvas and Books.
Redesign the main screen as a copy of Google Tasks.
